findings.summary: No single declaration bundles Corollary B.10. Its clauses are spread over exists_nominal_cone, the Certificate fields, seven Witness lemmas and the stress/analyticity lemmas, but they conjoin for the same W by logic alone.

The (B.40) order of choices is a property of the construction. It is visible only in the quantifier nesting of exists_ordered_prepared_continuation; the bare existential exists_nominal_cone cannot express it.

Controls records only kappa_le_one : kappa ≤ 1, while the paper fixes 0 < κ_0 < 1/2. At κ = 1 the activation factor (1−κ)σ(y/T) is identically zero, so the Lean existential does not guarantee a nontrivial flat factor.
